name: retry
prompt:
Explain what this Renyi program does in at most three sentences, for a reader who will decide whether to use it. Do not quote code.

module retry
  purpose: Retry a failing action with exponential backoff and jitter.

import std.time
import std.random

public type GaveUp
  purpose: The action still failed after the last attempt.
  has attempts: Integer
  has last_error: Text
end

public function with_backoff(
  action: function() returns Outcome or fails with Failure,
  attempts: Integer
)
  returns Outcome
  or fails with GaveUp
  needs time, random
  for any Outcome, Failure where Failure can ToText
  purpose: Run the action until it succeeds, waiting roughly twice as long after each failure.
  tags: resilience, backoff

  let mutable last_error be "no attempt was made"
  let mutable delay_ms be 100
  for each attempt from 1 to attempts
    match action()
      when success(outcome) then return outcome
      when failure(error) then
        set last_error to "attempt {attempt}: {error.to_text()}"
        let jitter_ms be random.integer(lowest: 0, highest: delay_ms.quotient(4))
        time.sleep(time.milliseconds(delay_ms + jitter_ms))
        set delay_ms to delay_ms * 2
    end
  end
  fail with GaveUp(attempts: attempts, last_error: last_error)
end
